noun_definition: Expense refers to a submitted financial entry that can be commented on and deleted within the transaction thread of the Expensify application.
Inconsistency refers to the differing behavior of the report details RHP closing or not closing when deleting expenses with comments in the transaction thread.

Report detail refers to the information displayed in the report header panel (RHP) that indicates the status of the report when an expense is deleted, specifically whether the panel closes or remains open based on the presence of comments.
rhp refers to the report details panel that is expected to close consistently when an expense with comments is deleted in the transaction thread.
Comment refers to a user-added note or remark associated with an expense in the transaction thread that is relevant to the behavior of the report details when the expense is deleted.
